description: Java source code for BigTextIntentService class, which handles snooze and dismiss actions for notifications in an Android wearables app, specifically managing BigTextStyle notifications.

classes.name: BigTextIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that manages snooze and dismiss actions for BigTextStyle notifications, including recreating notifications if the app process is killed.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to perform dismiss or snooze actions.

methods.name: handleActionDismiss
methods.description: Cancels the notification with the specified ID.

methods.name: handleActionSnooze
methods.description: Recreates the notification, cancels the current one, waits for a snooze period, then re-issues the notification.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigTextStyle
methods.description: Rebuilds the notification with BigTextStyle, including actions for snooze and dismiss, using data from a mock database.
